avoid: Heavy percussive shoes on hard floors
Complex 'nut' locks that might pinch fingers
children.game_version: Use foam 'swords' or pool noodles to learn the weaving patterns as a puzzle-solving game.

seniors.seated_version: Participants sit in a circle and use ribbons or lightweight flexible rods to simulate the weaving patterns without the weight or danger of steel.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the weaving figures at a walking pace without the jumping or rapid stepping, focusing on the arm coordination.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo by 50%; focus on upper body mobility.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands remain low, gripping the handles and tips of the flexible swords to form a continuous chain.
movement_profile.footwork: Rapid rhythmic stepping, often described as a form of clog dancing or 'shuffling' in time with the music.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: A very tight circle that moves as a single unit; requires minimal floor space but high vertical clearance for jumps.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Relatively stable, with most movement occurring in the legs and through the weaving of the arms.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes jumping over the flexible blades while maintaining the grip.
movement_profile.partnering: Collective; all five dancers are physically linked throughout the majority of the dance.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and compact to allow for tight circular weaving.

signature_moves.description: The swords are woven together into a five-pointed star and held aloft by the leader.
signature_moves.name: The Nut

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Releasing the sword grip during figures; losing the rhythmic timing which can lead to entanglement.

music_profile.musical_form: Binary folk tunes repeated for different dance figures
music_profile.sound_description: A solo fiddle playing fast-paced traditional Northumbrian tunes, punctuated by the rhythmic percussive sound of five dancers' feet and the occasional metallic clink of flexible steel blades.
music_profile.vocal_style: Introductory songs or speeches by the Tommy character

basic_steps: Form a circle of five dancers
Each dancer grasps the handle of their own sword and the tip of the sword to their left
Execute weaving figures (under and over swords) while maintaining the circle
Lock swords into a 'nut' or star formation
teaching.formation: Closed circle of five dancers linked by swords
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical agility and group synchronization; the flexibility of the rapper swords is essential for the movements.
